info.title: NugetDeFrog
info.description: A DotNet command line tool to create a project that references only the runtime packages from an applications *.deps.json file.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the output project file. (Default: RuntimePackages\RuntimePackages.csproj)

options.name: --windows
options.description: Use windows target platform; required if any of the projects require windows platform

options.name: --consolidate
options.description: Consolidate multiple versions of the same package to the highest version. By default, the tool will fail if multiple versions of the same package are found.
